scheme_name: Pension Scheme to the Dependents (Husband/Wife) of Identified State Agitators, Other than those Who either went to Jail for 7 Days or were Injured During the Uttarakhand State Movement, after the Death of the Agitator
description:
The Pension Scheme to the Dependents of Identified State Agitators is a welfare initiative launched by the Government of Uttarakhand. 

This scheme was introduced to provide financial support to the dependents of those individuals who actively participated in the Uttarakhand state movement. 

The movement aimed at the creation of a separate state of Uttarakhand from the larger state of Uttar Pradesh. 

The scheme specifically targets the dependents of agitators who did not go to jail for a minimum of seven days nor suffered injuries during the movement. 

The Uttarakhand state was officially formed on November 9, 2000. 

The pension scheme was launched to acknowledge the sacrifices made by these agitators and to provide a safety net for their families after their demise. 

The main objective of the scheme is to ensure that the dependents of these identified state agitators receive a monthly pension to support their livelihood. 

The government aims to provide financial assistance to the dependents to help them maintain a basic standard of living. 

The monthly pension amount is set at ₹5,000. 

This amount is intended to help cover essential living expenses such as food, housing, and healthcare. 

The scheme is designed to provide long-term financial security to the dependents of the identified agitators. 

Eligibility for this scheme is limited to the dependents of those who were recognized as state agitators. 

Dependents include the husband or wife of the deceased agitator. 

To qualify for the pension, the applicant must provide proof of their relationship to the agitator. 

The applicant must also provide documentation proving that the agitator was part of the movement but did not go to jail for seven days or suffer injuries. 

The application process involves several steps. 

First, the applicant must obtain the application form from the official Uttarakhand government website or designated government offices. 

The form requires the applicant to fill in personal details including their name, address, and relationship to the deceased agitator. 

The applicant must also submit a copy of the agitator's identification documents. 

Additionally, proof of the agitator's participation in the state movement must be included. 

This could include affidavits or certificates issued by recognized organizations involved in the movement. 

Once the application form is completed, it must be submitted to the designated office of the Department of Social Welfare in Uttarakhand. 

The application will then be reviewed by the authorities to verify the information provided. 

If approved, the pension will be disbursed monthly to the dependents' bank account. 

The pension is expected to be credited on the first day of every month. 

This ensures that the dependents receive timely financial assistance. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Uttarakhand. 

Contact details for the department can be found on the official Uttarakhand government website. 

The department is responsible for processing applications and disbursing pensions. 

They also handle any grievances or issues related to the pension scheme. 

The scheme is part of a broader effort by the Uttarakhand government to support families of individuals who contributed to the state's formation. 

The government recognizes the importance of providing financial stability to these families. 

As of October 2023, the scheme continues to operate and provide benefits to eligible dependents. 

The government has allocated a budget specifically for this scheme to ensure its sustainability. 

Regular reviews are conducted to assess the impact of the scheme and make necessary adjustments. 

The pension scheme serves as a recognition of the sacrifices made by the agitators during the state movement. 

It aims to honor their legacy by supporting their families in a meaningful way. 

The scheme has been positively received by the families of the identified state agitators. 

Many dependents have expressed gratitude for the financial assistance provided. 

The government has also emphasized the importance of raising awareness about the scheme. 

Efforts are made to ensure that eligible dependents are informed about the benefits available to them. 

Workshops and informational sessions are conducted to educate families on how to apply for the pension. 

This outreach is crucial to ensure that no eligible dependent is left without support. 

The pension scheme is a testament to the commitment of the Uttarakhand government to its citizens. 

It reflects the government's dedication to honoring the contributions of those who fought for the state's creation. 

The scheme is an important step towards ensuring social justice and welfare for the families of state agitators. 

Overall, the Pension Scheme to the Dependents of Identified State Agitators is a vital initiative that provides essential support to families in need. 

It plays a significant role in the social welfare landscape of Uttarakhand. 

The government continues to monitor and evaluate the scheme to enhance its effectiveness. 

This ensures that the benefits reach those who need them the most. 

The pension scheme stands as a symbol of recognition and respect for the sacrifices made during the Uttarakhand state movement. 

It is a crucial component of the broader welfare policies implemented by the Uttarakhand government. 

The scheme not only provides financial assistance but also fosters a sense of community and support among the families of state agitators. 

The government remains committed to ensuring that the legacy of the state movement is honored through such initiatives. 

This pension scheme is a vital resource for the dependents of those who played a role in shaping the state of Uttarakhand. 

It is an essential part of the ongoing efforts to support and uplift the families of those who contributed to the state's history.
